purpose: Let agents discover typed layer constructors and inspect current workspace/graph state without reading generated glue or reconstructing semantics from binary plans.

agentLayerCatalog.guarantee: covers every constructor advertised by agentCapabilities

describeGraph.returns: ordered semantic graph topology plus live registry binding
describeGraph.metadata_policy: workspace metadata is used when present; missing variant/constructor metadata is null and is never guessed

graph_description.configured_output: AgentGraphBuilder configured output, or null if unset
graph_description.program_identity: not claimed before compilation; CompiledGraph.programIdentity remains authoritative after compile
graph_description.semantic_graph_identity: separate topology+semantic-binding fingerprint; explicitly does not replace CompiledGraph.programIdentity
graph_description.external_input_contract: the same optional external input contract is surfaced alongside topology
graph_description.external_input_port: the same optional semantic role/provenance descriptor for slot 0 is surfaced alongside topology
graph_description.runtime_subject: the same bound runtime subject is surfaced alongside graph topology for state-loss recovery and receipt correlation
graph_description.runtime_program_binding: pre-compile builder description cannot claim an exact program binding; use workspaceRuntimeProgramBinding after compilation

workspace_description.proof_scope: legacy recordProof, caller attestations, and verifier receipts are counted separately; authority classes are never merged
workspace_description.external_input_contract: optional slot-0 f32 rank-4 metadata projected from AgentWorkspace; unbound remains explicit
workspace_description.external_input_port: optional slot-0 semantic role/provenance metadata projected from AgentWorkspace; unbound remains explicit
workspace_description.runtime_subject: optional Resolution↔Runtime execution-context tuple carried by AgentWorkspace; authorization remains owned by the semantic host boundary
workspace_description.runtime_program_bindings: bounded count of exact CompiledGraph.programIdentity values associated with the immutable runtime subject; identities are not inferred

invariants: no hidden mutable introspection state is introduced
missing semantic metadata is reported as null/unknown rather than inferred
registry presence is observation, not ownership transfer
constructor catalog success does not replace constructor or runtime validation
binary program plan and CompiledGraph identity remain canonical machine execution identity
subject-program binding is reported only from recorded exact programIdentity state and is never inferred from similar topology
semantic input port metadata is reported only from explicit workspace binding and is never inferred from free-form semantics text
persistent semantic edge bindings are reported only from AgentGraphBuilder binding state and never inferred from layer type
semantic graph identity and executable program identity remain distinct authority classes
deferred: automatic graph repair or action selection
